title: Sections and local equality after sheafification on a site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $\mathcal F$ be a presheaf of sets on $\mathcal C$, and let $\theta^2:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F^\#$ be its sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. For every object $U$ and section $s\in\mathcal F^\#(U)$, there is a covering $(U_i\to U)_{i\in I}$ and sections $s_i\in\mathcal F(U_i)$ such that $s|_{U_i}=\theta^2(s_i)$ and, for every $i,j$, the pullbacks of $s_i$ and $s_j$ agree after a further covering of $U_i\times_UU_j$. Conversely, any such compatible local sections glue uniquely to a section of $\mathcal F^\#(U)$. In particular, if $p,q\in\mathcal F(U)$ have equal images in $\mathcal F^\#(U)$, then there is a covering $(U_i\to U)_{i\in I}$ on which $p|_{U_i}=q|_{U_i}$. This is Sites, Theorem Tag 00WB (theorem-plus) and Lemma Tag 00WK (lemma-sections-sheafification).

source.place: Sites, Theorem Tag 00WB (theorem-plus), especially parts (2) and (4), and Lemma Tag 00WK (lemma-sections-sheafification)
